title: Present complementary private Route Operator and Gate Operator controls
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Render the approved private operation popup for only the assigned Route Operator or Gate Operator. Show exactly the three incident-specific named choices with large original full-colour icons resolved from semantic option keys, plus the recipient complementary safe/corrupted route or gate diagnostics. Do not expose the other operator choice, diagnostic or secret alignment. Never substitute A/B/C,1/2/3-only controls or literal Repair/Sabotage buttons. Submit operation-choice{optionId,expectedRevision} through the reviewed adapter with one clear local confirmation and pending/locked state; non-Crew viewers receive public progress only. Deadline fallback is authority-owned. Declare this presentation module readonly props locally from the documented fields and accept injected callbacks/asset lookups; do not import an unfinished server implementation. A035/A048 adapt canonical production DTOs and parsed intents into these props. The canonical producer contracts are A025 observeMatchV1/getLegalActionsV1 and A056 versioned recipient DTOs (A067 projects multiplayer views); public/private/legal fields must originate there, never raw hidden MatchStateV1. A004 owns exact I01–I06 option labels and all36 semantic icon keys.
acceptance: Each of six incidents maps to the correct three named Route or Gate icon choices and recipient-only diagnostic fields.
Static and Archivist operators use the same controls; neither alignment nor the partner choice can be inferred from layout/payload.
Only a supplied legal option key can emit operation-choice once; pending, expired, spectator and non-Crew states cannot act.
Keyboard/assistive interactions and reduced-motion static icons remain legible; no private choice enters public recap/storage/media/ad events.
designSections: RULES-SPEC-v1: 4. The deterministic Crew Operation, 5.1 Incident icon system; SCREEN-FLOW: 9. Repair Crew emergency
